caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of two main parts: a large, dark, irregularly shaped base that appears solid and somewhat elongated with a rough surface, and an attached curved metal arm, which is thin and angular. The base is primarily a deep brownish-black in color, with subtle variations indicating texture and shading. The metal arm rises upward from the back edge of the base, bends at an angle, and then curves again to form a hooked end. The junction where the arm connects to the base includes a loop or ring, possibly as part of the attachment mechanism. The background is plain and light, with a simple rectangular border drawn around the object. The overall color palette of the drawing is muted, with earth tones and minimal use of any bright color. The artist's name and some numbers appear neatly in the bottom margin.
title: Betty Lamp
